title: Normalized completed ringed models and ordinary open comparisons
statement: For a prime l and finite coefficient extension E, there exist RingedModels d and RingedOpenComparisons for d (def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge) on all schemes. They retain the published strict quotient-tower unit and pure-tensor normalizations, the equality of ordinary tensor with calculus.integralClosed.tensor, its representative equation, and the actual open-unit transposes for base change, projection and clopen comparison. This asserts neither a system operation nor a proper/open gamma or its adjunct.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed calculus tensor representative and quotientChain. The tensor-completion lemma supplies its normalized comparison. Assemble Tensor, proving its chain normalization by tensorOperationUnit_normalized. Combine the pull-completion presentation at each morphism with these tensors to construct RingedModels. Its tensorClosed field is reflexivity, and tensorRepresentative is the defining restriction of the calculus representative isomorphism.

proof.text: Use derived slice extension to prove the actual open unit invertible. Invert the specified reverse open mate using its cartesian invertibility theorem. Form the projection natural isomorphism from openProjectionIso and its proved naturality; its inverse transpose is the defining equation of openProjectionInverse. Use asIso of the inverse-unit clopen map. Equiv.apply_symm_apply proves the base-change and projection transpose equations; the clopen transpose equation is definitional. Assemble RingedOpenComparisons for the constructed models. No proper/open interchange or system operation is assumed.
